status_effects.explanation: Forcheville is denied any sign of genuine affection from Odette and is more completely deceived than his rival Swann, leaving him diminished in the romantic rivalry.

appraisal_events.evidence: Pour Forcheville rien de tel : aucune allusion qui pût faire supposer une intrigue entre eux... Forcheville était en tout ceci plus trompé que lui, puisque Odette lui écrivait pour lui faire croire que le visiteur était son oncle.
appraisal_events.explanation: Odette's letter withholds any tender language toward Forcheville and actively deceives him about who her visitor was, marking him as more thoroughly duped and less favored than Swann.
